description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs - Agreement between Sri Lanka Govt. and the International Centre for Research in Agroforestry (ICRAF) - Agreement on the Privileges and Immunities of the International Atomic Energy Agency (GGGI) - Sri Lanka Govt.and the Global Green Growth Institute regarding the Legal Status (IAEA)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of legal privileges and immunities under the Diplomatic Privileges Act, No. 9 of 1996. It outlines the application of this legal framework to a specific international agreement between the Sri Lankan government and ICRAF, detailing tax exemptions, customs duties, and legal immunities. While it mentions a government minister (M. U. M. Ali Sabry), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content focuses on establishing legal and regulatory frameworks for international organizations, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
